1.

Thou comest soon, our great Captain of Salvation, Thou who to glory a company dost lead; Thou comest soon, our Bridegroom gracious and faithful; Thy bride, who waits, distinctly hears Thy voice.

2.

Thou shalt come, no longer art Thou detained By the heavens, which have hidden Thee from our sight, Innumerable the saints who follow Thee, When Thou dost reveal Thyself in the clouds.

3.

Thou, “the Prince over all the kings of the earth!” Soon earth’s powers must bow themselves, Soon the tumult of war by the sceptre of peace is stilled, And every kingdom subdued beneath Thee.

4.

“I come quickly.” Thou Thyself hast said it, Lord. We hear the word still from the Father’s throne. It gladdens Thee to hear our heart’s response: “Yea, amen, come, Lord Jesus, come!”
